mines.mine_notes: 100%-owned flagship silver-gold project in the central Deseado Massif, Santa Cruz, Argentina (~60 km west of Cerro Leon, connected via Provincial Route 12). Covers a single epithermal vein system extending 10 km N-S and 12 km E-W. Acquired October 2024. MRE update (Mar 2026): 45.3 Mt @ 115 g/t AgEq = 167 Moz AgEq (143% increase since acquisition), incl. 123 Moz Ag and 521 koz Au; 78% Indicated; underpinned by 27,723 m drilling since Apr 2025. Historical PAAS production 4.3 Moz Ag (2019-2021). New discoveries at La Morocha SE; extensional drilling at La Negra/La Negra SE. Phase 1 'Oxide First' strategy: free-milling pit-constrained resources as basis of maiden PFS (Q3 2026) - open-pit mining + whole-ore cyanidation (Merrill-Crowe). Joaquin AgEq = Ag + Au*84.9 (@ $40/oz Ag 82% rec; $3,200/oz Au 87% rec). [production_notes: No production - exploration/development stage. 30,000 m drill program at Joaquin/Cerro Leon (reported 91 holes, 14,594 m assays since Sep 2025); drilling capacity 3->5 rigs after Nov 2025 A$40M placement.] [primary_commodity: Silver] [cost_breakdown_notes: Exploration/development stage; no operating costs. Joaquin all-in discovery cost US$11c per AgEq oz; Cerro Leon discovery cost US$10c per AgEq oz. Maiden PFS on track for Q3 2026.]

Flagship polymetallic project in the Deseado Massif, Santa Cruz, Argentina. MRE (Sep 2025): 31 Mt @ 161 g/t AgEq = 162 Moz AgEq (73% increase on May 2023 MRE), incl. 62 Moz Ag, 548 koz Au, 778 Mlb Zn, 364 Mlb Pb; Indicated 9.4 Mt @ 190 g/t AgEq = 57.8 Moz AgEq; Inferred 21.3 Mt @ 154 g/t = 104 Moz AgEq. Oxide free-milling resources: 8.1 Mt @ 171 g/t AgEq = 45 Moz AgEq (67% Indicated) supporting PLUS 150 oxide strategy. High-grade mineralisation open at depth and along strike at all prospects. Shallow oxide Ag-Au mineralisation has satellite-feed potential to a centralised Joaquin processing facility. Cerro Leon AgEq = Ag + 96.76*Au + 20.99*Pb% + 32.48*Zn% (@ $30/oz Ag 90% rec; $2,750/oz Au 95% rec; $0.95/lb Pb 87% rec; $1.39/lb Zn 92% rec). [production_notes: No production - exploration/development stage.] [primary_commodity: Silver] [cost_breakdown_notes: Exploration/development stage; no operating costs.]
